text: I'll start by looking at the workspace layout.
The bug is visible at line 31: `end = start + page_size - 1` is an inclusive index, and it's then likely used as an exclusive slice bound, dropping one item per page. Let me read the file to confirm.

Confirmed: `items[start:end]` with `end = start + page_size - 1` drops the last item of every full page (e.g., item 5, 10), which matches the "regular interval" symptom. The fix is to make `end` the exclusive bound.

args.summary: Fixed an off-by-one in `library/pagination.py` `paginate()`. The end index was computed as `start + page_size - 1` but used as an exclusive slice bound in `items[start:end]`, so the last item of every full page was silently dropped (e.g., items 5 and 10 with page size 5), producing the periodic gaps described in the report. Changed it to `end = start + page_size`. The full test suite passes (29/29).
